name: Fluorescence Colocalization Analysis
description: You are a cell biologist analyzing protein co-localization in fluorescence microscopy data. Open the built-in 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells). This RGB image shows cells stained with multiple fluorescent markers. Perform a quantitative colocalization analysis between the red and green channels: measure the thresholded area covered by each channel, the mean fluorescence intensity within each channel's thresholded region, the pixel-level overlap area between the two channels, and compute at least one colocalization coefficient (Pearson correlation coefficient r, Manders overlap coefficients M1 and/or M2, or intersection-over-union). Save all measurements with clear column headers to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/colocalization_results.csv. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.

metadata.image_source: Fiji built-in sample (File > Open Samples > Fluorescent Cells)
